item.title: Introducing Pi-Go
item.description: pi-go is a terminal-based AI coding agent built on Google ADK Go. It ships as a single binary, runs multiple LLM providers side by side, keeps your filesystem safe behind a sandbox, and remembers what you've worked on across sessions. This post introduces the project, the reasoning behind it, and the six pillars that make pi-go different: multi-provider LLMs, sandboxed tools, Memory Palace, LSP integration, a subagent system, and session branching.
